text: Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain Fatir ki bilkul theek ma'ani main ne sab se pehle ek A'arabi ki zaban se sun kar maloom kiye. Woh apne ek saathi A'arabi se jhagarta hua aaya, ek kunwein ke bare mein un ka ikhtilaf tha, toh A'arabi ne kaha "Ana fatartuha" ya'ni pehle pehal main ne hi ise banaya hai. Pas ma'ani yeh hue ke ibtida-e-benamuna sirf apni qudrat-e-kamilah se Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne zameen-o-aasman ko paida kiya. Zahhak se marwi hai ke Fatir ke ma'ani Khaliq ke hain. Apne aur apne Nabiyon ke darmiyan qasid us ne apne farishton ko banaya hai. Jo par wale hain, urte hain taake jaldi se Allah ka paigham us ke Rasoolon tak pahuncha dein. Is mein se ba'az do paron wale hain, ba'az ke teen teen hain, ba'az ke chaar chaar par hain. Ba'az in se bhi zyada hain. Chunancha hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Jibraeel A.S ko dekha un ke chhe sau par the aur har do par ke darmiyan mashriq-o-maghrib jitna fasla tha. Yahan bhi farmata hai Rabb jo chahe apni makhlooq mein zyadati kare. Jis se chahta hai us se bhi zyada par kar deta hai aur kainat mein jo chahe rachata hai. Is se murad achi aawaz bhi li gayi. Chunancha ek shaaz qira'at "Fi al-halq" "Ha" ke saath bhi hai. Wallahu A'alam.

Allah Ta'ala ka chaha hua sab kuch ho kar rehta hai baghair uski chahat ke kuch bhi nahin hota. Jo woh de use koi rokne wala nahin. Aur jise woh rok le use koi dene wala nahin. Namaz-e-farz ke salam ke baad Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamesha yeh kalmaat parhte. Aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) fazool goi aur kasrat-e-sawaal aur maal ki barbadi se mana farmate thay aur aap larkiyon ko zinda dargor karne aur maaon ki nafarmaniyan karne aur khud lene aur dusron ko na dene se bhi rokte thay (Bukhari, Muslim waghera). Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ruku se sar uthate hue isi aayat jaisi aayat (Wa-in yamsaskallahu bidurrin fala kashifa lahu illa huwa, wa-in yamsaska bikhairin fahuwa 'ala kulli shai-in qadeer) (Surah Al-An'am: 17) hai. Aur bhi iski nazeer ki aayatein bahut si hain. Hazrat Imam Malik (R.H / Rahimahullah) farmate hain ke barish barasti to Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) farmate hum par fath ke taare se barish barsayi gayi. Phir isi aayat ki tilawat karte (Ibn Abi Hatim).

Is baat ki daleel yahan ho rahi hai ke ibadaton ke laiq sirf Allah hi ki zaat hai kyunke Khaliq-o-Raziq sirf wahi hai. Phir us ke siwa dusron ki ibadat karna faash ghalti hai. Dar-asal us ke siwa laiq-e-ibadat aur koi nahin. Phir tum is wazeh daleel aur zahir burhan ke baad kaise behak rahe ho? Aur dusron ki ibadat ki taraf jhuke jate ho? Wallahu A'lam.

Mayusi ki muman'at. Aye Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) agar aap ke zamane ke kuffar aap ki mukhalifat karein aur aap ki batayi hui tauheed aur khud aap ki sachi risalat ko jhutlayein. Toh aap shikasta dil na ho jaya karein. Agle nabiyon ke sath bhi yahi hota raha. Sab kamon ka marja Allah ki taraf hai. Woh sab ko un ke tamam kamon ka badla de ga aur saza jaza sab kuch hogi, logo Qayamat ka din haq hai woh yaqeenan aane wala hai woh wada atal hai. Wahan ki nematon ke badle yahan ke fani aish par ulajh na jao. Duniya ki zahiri aish kahin tumhein wahan ki haqiqi khushi se mehroom na kar de. Isi tarah Shaitan makkar se bhi hoshiyar rehna. Us ke chalte phirte jadoo mein na phans jana. Us ki jhooti aur chakni chupri baton mein aa kar Allah Rasool ke haq kalam ko na chhor baithna. Surah Luqman ke aakhir mein bhi yahi farmaya hai. Pas ghuroor yani dhoke baz yahan Shaitan ko kaha gaya hai. Jab musalmanon aur munafiqon ke darmiyan Qayamat ke din deewar khari kar di jaye gi jis mein darwaza hoga. Jis ke androoni hisse mein rahmat hogi aur zahiri hisse mein azab hoga us waqt munafiqeen momineen se kahenge ke kya hum tumhare sathi na thay? Yeh jawab denge ke haan sath toh thay lekin tum ne toh apne tayin fitne mein daal diya tha aur sochte hi rahe shak shuba door hi na kiya khwahishon ko poora karne mein doobe rahe. Yahan tak ke Allah ka hukum aa pohancha aur dhoke baz Shaitan ne tumhein behlawe mein hi rakha. Is ayat mein bhi Shaitan ko ghuroor kaha gaya hai, phir shaitani dushmani ko bayan kiya ke woh toh tumhein mutala kar ke tumhari dushmani aur barbadi ka beera uthaye hue hai. Phir tum kyun us ki baton mein aa jate ho? Aur us ke dhoke mein phans jate ho? Us ki aur us ki fauj ki toh ain tamanna hai ke woh tumhein bhi apne sath ghaseet kar Jahannam mein le jaye. Allah Ta'ala Qawi-o-Aziz se hamari dua hai ke woh hamein Shaitan ka dushman hi rakhe aur us ke makr se hamein mehfooz rakhe aur apni Kitab aur apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sunnaton ki pairwi ki taufeeq ata farmaye. Woh har cheez par qadir hai aur duayon ka qabool farmane wala hai. Jis tarah is ayat mein Shaitan ki dushmani ka bayan kiya gaya hai. Isi tarah Surah Kahf ki ayat (Wa iz qulna lil-mala'ikatis-judu li-Adama fasajadu illa Iblisa kana minal-jinni fafasaqa an amri rabbihi, afatattakhizunahu wa zurriyatahu awliya'a min duni wa hum lakum aduwwun, bi'sa liz-zalimina badala) (18. Al-Kahf: 50) mein bhi us ki dushmani ka zikr hai.

Upar bayan guzra tha ke Shaitan ke tabe-daron ki jagah Jahannam hai. Is liye yahan bayan ho raha hai ke kuffar ke liye sakht azab hai. Is liye ke yeh Shaitan ke tabe aur Rahman ke nafarman hain. Mominon se jo gunah bhi ho jayen bahut mumkin hai ke Allah unhein maaf farma de aur jo nekiyan un ki hain un par unhein bada bhari ajar-o-sawab milega, kafir aur badkar log apni bad-amaliyon ko nekiyan samajh baithe hain toh aise gumrah logon par tera kya bas hai? Hidayat-o-gumrahi Allah ke hath hai. Pas tujhe un par ghamgeen na hona chahiye. Muqaddarat Allah jari ho chuke hain. Maslahat Malik-ul-Mulook ko is ke siwa koi nahin janta. Hidayat-o-zalalat mein bhi us ki hikmat hai koi kaam is sachay Hakeem ka hikmat se khali nahin. Logon ke tamam af'aal us par wazeh hain. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne apni tamam makhlooq ko andheray mein paida kiya phir un par apna noor dala pas jis par woh noor pad gaya woh duniya mein aa kar seedhi rah chala aur jisay us din woh noor na mila woh duniya mein aa kar bhi hidayat se behra-war na ho saka isi liye main kehta hoon ke Allah Azza-wa-Jal ke ilm ke mutabiq qalam chal kar khushk ho gaya. (Ibn Abi Hatim) Aur riwayat mein hai ke hamaray paas Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaye aur farmaya Allah ke liye har tareef hai jo gumrahi se hidayat par lata hai aur jis par chahta hai gumrahi khalt-malt kar deta hai yeh hadith bhi bahut hi ghareeb hai.

Maut ke baad zindagi. Quran-e-Kareem mein maut ke baad ki zindagi par umooman khushk zameen ke hara hone se istidlal kiya gaya hai. Jaise Surah Hajj waghera mein hai. Bandon ke liye is mein poori ibrat aur murdon ke zinda hone ki poori daleel is mein majood hai ke zameen bilkul sookhi padi hai, koi taro-tazgi is mein nazar nahin aati lekin badal uthte hain, pani barasta hai ke us ki khushki tazgi se aur us ki maut zindagi se badal jati hai. Ya to ek tinka nazar na aata tha ya koson tak hariyali hi hariyali ho jati hai. Isi tarah Bani Adam ke ajza qabron mein bikhre pade honge ek se ek alag hoga. Lekin Arsh ke neeche se pani baraste hi tamam jism qabron mein se ugne lagenge. Jaise zameen se dane alag aate hain. Chunancha Sahih Hadith mein hai Ibn-e-Adam tamam ka tamam gal sad jata hai lekin reedh ki haddi nahin sadti isi se paida kiya gaya hai aur is se tarkeeb diya jayega. Yahan bhi nishan bata kar farmaya ke isi tarah maut ke baad ki zeest hai. Surah Hajj ki tafsir mein yeh hadith guzar chuki hai ke Abu Razin (R.A) ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se poocha ke Huzoor (ﷺ) Allah Ta'ala murdon ko kis tarah zinda karega? Aur is ki makhlooq mein is baat ki kya daleel hai? Aap ne farmaya ae Abu Razin kya tum apni basti ke aas paas ki zameen ke paas se is halat mein nahin guzre ke woh khushk banjar padi hui hoti hai. Phir dobara tum guzarte ho to dekhte ho ke woh sabza-zar bani hui hai aur tazgi ke sath lehra rahi hai. Hazrat Abu Razin ne jawab diya haan Huzoor (ﷺ) yeh to aksar dekhne mein aaya hai. Aap ne farmaya bas isi tarah Allah Ta'ala murdon ko zinda kar dega, jo shakhs duniya aur aakhirat mein ba-izzat rehna chahta ho use Allah Ta'ala ki itaat-guzari karni chahiye wahi is maqsad ka poora karne wala hai, duniya aur aakhirat ka malik wahi hai. Sari izzatein usi ki malkiyat mein hain. Chunancha aur aayat mein hai ke jo log mominon ko chhod kar kuffar se dostiyan karte hain ke un ke paas hamari izzat ho woh izzat ke husool se mayoos ho jayen kyunke izzat to Allah ke qabze mein hai aur jagah farman-e-aali shan hai tujhe un ki baatein gham-naak na karein, tamam tar izzatein Allah hi ke liye hain aur aayat mein Allah Jalla Jalaluhu ka farman hai yani izzatein Allah hi ke liye hain aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke liye aur imaan walon ke liye lekin munafiq be-ilm hain. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain buton ki parastish mein izzat nahin izzat wala to Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Pas ba-qaul Qatada aayat ka yeh matlab hai ke talib-e-izzat ko ahkam-e-Allah ki tameel mein mashghool rehna chahiye aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke jo yeh janna chahta ho ke kis ke liye izzat hai woh jaan le ke sari izzatein Allah hi ke liye hain. Zikr tilawat dua waghera pak kalme usi ki taraf chadhte hain. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) farmate hain jitni hadeesein tumhare samne bayan karte hain. Sab ki tasdeeq Kitabullah se pesh kar sakte hain. Suno! Musalman banda jab padhta hai to in kalmaat ko farishta apne par tale le kar aasman par chadh jata hai.

Farishton ke jis majmay ke paas se guzarta hai woh majma un kalmaat ke kehne wale ke liye istighfar karta hai. Yahan tak ke Rabb-ul-Aalameen Azzawajal ke samne yeh kalmaat pesh kiye jate hain. Phir Aap (ﷺ) ne (اِلَيْهِ يَصْعَدُ الْكَلِمُ الطَّيِّبُ وَالْعَمَلُ الصَّالِحُ يَرْفَعُهٗ) (Surah Fatir: 10) yarfa'uhu ki tilawat ki. (Ibn-e-Jarir). Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar (R.A) farmate hain SubhanAllah aur La ilaha illallah aur Allahu Akbar Arsh ke gird-o-pesh ahista ahista aawaz nikalte rehte hain. Jaise shehad ki makkhiyon ki bhanbhanaahat hoti hai. Apne kehne wale ka zikr Allah ke samne karte rehte hain aur nek aamaal khazanon mein mehfooz rehte hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain jo log Allah ka jalal, uski tasbeeh, uski hamd, uski badai, uski wahdaniyat ka zikr karte rehte hain. Un ke liye un ke yeh kalmaat Arsh ke aas paas Allah ke samne un ka zikr karte rehte hain, kya tum nahin chahte ke koi na koi tumhara zikr tumhare Rabb ke samne karta rahe? Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka farman hai ke paak kalmon se murad zikr-e-Allah hai aur amal-e-saleh se murad faraiz ki adaigi hai. Pas jo shakhs zikr-e-Allah aur adaye fareeza kare us ka amal us ke zikr ko Allah Ta'ala ki taraf charhata hai. Aur jo zikr kare lekin fareeza ada na kare us ka kalam us ke amal par lota diya jata hai. Isi tarah Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain ke Kalma-e-Tayyab ko amal-e-saleh le jata hai aur buzurgon se bhi yahi manqool hai, balkay Iyas bin Muawiyah Qazi farmate hain qaul baghair amal ke mardood hai. Buraiyon ke ghaat mein lagne wale woh log hain jo makkari aur riyakari ke aamaal karte hon. Logon par goya yeh zahir ho ke woh Allah ki farmanbardari karte hain lekin darasal Allah ke nazdeek woh sab se zyada bure hain jo nekiyan sirf dikhawe ki karte hain. Yeh zikr-e-Allah bohat hi kam karte hain. Abdur-Rahman farmate hain is se murad mushrik hain. Lekin yeh sahih hai ke yeh aayat aam hai, mushrik is mein batareeq-e-aula dakhil hain. Un ke liye sakht azaab hai aur un ka makr fasid-o-batil hai. Un ka jhoot aaj nahin to kal khul jayega, aqalmand un ke makr se waqif ho jayenge. Jo shakhs jo kuch kare us ka asar us ke chehre par hi zahir ho jata hai, us ki zaban usi rang se rang di jati hai. Jaisa batin hota hai usi ka aks zahir par bhi parta hai. Riyakar ki beimani lambi muddat tak posheeda nahin reh sakti, haan koi bewaqoof us ke daam mein phans jaye to aur baat hai. Momin poore aqalmand aur kamil dana hote hain, woh in dhoke bazon se bakhoobi aagah ho jate hain aur us Aalim-ul-Ghaib Allah par to koi baat bhi chup nahin sakti. Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare baap Hazrat Adam (A.S) ko mitti se paida kiya aur un ki nasal ko ek zaleel pani se jaari rakha. Phir tumhein jora jora banaya yani mard-o-aurat. Yeh bhi us ka lutf-o-karam aur inaam-o-ehsaan hai ke mardon ke liye biwiyan banayin jo un ke sukoon-o-rahat ka sabab hain. Har hamila ke hamal ki aur har bachay ke tawallud hone ki use khabar hai.

Balkeh har pattay ke jharne aur andheray mein paray huay daanay aur har tar-o-khushk cheez ka usay ilm hai balkeh us ki kitab mein woh likha hua hai. Isi aayat jaisi (ALLAHU YA'LAMU MA TAHMILU KULLU UNSA WAMA TAGHIDUL ARHAMU WAMA TAZDADU. WA KULLU SHAY'IN INDAHU BIMIQDAR) (13. Ar-Ra'd: 8) al-kh, hai aur wahin us ki poori tafsir bhi guzar chuki hai. Isi tarah Allah Ta'ala Aalim-ul-Ghaib ko yeh bhi ilm hai ke kis nutfay ko lambi umar milne wali hai. Yeh bhi us ke paas likha hua hai (WA LA YUNQASU MIN UMURIHI ILLA FI KITAB) (35. Fatir: 11) mein 'ha' ki zameer ka marja' jins hai. Ain wahi nahin is liye ke tool-e-umar kitab mein hai aur Allah Ta'ala ke ilm mein us ki umar se kami nahin hoti. Jins ki taraf bhi zameer laut-ti hai. Allah Ta'ala apni qudrat-e-kamilah ka bayan farma raha hai ke usne raat ko andhere wali aur din ko roshni wala banaya hai. Kabhi ki raatein badi, kabhi ke din bade. Kabhi dono yaksan. Kabhi jaade hain kabhi garmiyan hain. Usi ne suraj aur chand ko thame hue aur chalte phirte sitaron ko muti' kar rakha hai. Bhala batao toh Allah jaisi sacchi khabrein aur kaun de sakta hai? Jo usne farmaya woh yaqeenan ho kar hi rahega. Jo kuch hone wala hai us se Allah Ta'ala pura khabardar hai isi jaisi khabar koi aur nahin de sakta.

Allah ki qudrat hai agar woh chahe to tum sab ko gharat-o-barbad kar de aur tumhare ewaz dusre logon ko laye, Rabb par yeh kaam kuch mushkil nahin. Hazrat Ikrama (R.A) farmate hain, padosi padosi ke peeche pad jayega, Allah se arz karega ke is se pooch to sahi ke isne mujh se apna darwaza kyun band kar liya tha? Baap apne bete ko apne ehsan jatayega aur kahega ke rai ke ek dane barabar mujhe aaj apni nekiyon mein se de de, woh kahega abba aap cheez to thodi si talab farma rahe hain lekin aaj to jo khatka aap ko hai wahi mujhe bhi hai, main to kuch bhi nahin de sakta. Phir biwi ke paas jayega, us se kahega main ne tere sath duniya mein kaise sulook kiye hain? Woh kahegi bahut hi achhe, yeh kahega aaj main tera mohtaj hoon, mujhe ek neki de de taake azabon se chhoot jaun, jawab milega ke sawal to bahut halka hai lekin jis khauf mein tum ho wahi dar mujhe bhi laga hua hai, main to kuch bhi sulook aaj nahin kar sakti. Har shakhs apne haal mein samat-o-bekhud hoga.

Har ek dusre se ghafil hoga, tere wa'z-o-nasihat se wahi log faida utha sakte hain jo aql-mand aur sahib-e-firasat hon jo apne Rabb se qadam-qadam par khauf karne wale aur ita'at-e-Allah karte hue namazon ko pabandi ke sath ada karne wale hain. Nek a'maal khud tum hi ko nafa denge jo pakeezgiyan tum karo un ka nafa tum hi ko pahunche ga. Aakhir Allah ke paas jana hai, us ke samne pesh hona hai, hisab-kitab us ke samne hona hai, a'maal ka badla woh khud dene wala hai.

Jaise farmaya (Awa man kana maytan fa-ahyaynahu wa ja'alna lahu nooran yamshi bihi fin-nasi kaman mathaluhu fiz-zulumati laysa bi-kharijim minha, kazalika zuyyina lil-kafirina ma kanu ya'malun) (Surah Al-An'am: 122), yani jo murda tha phir use hum ne zinda kar diya aur use noor diya jise liye hue logon mein chal phir raha hai aisa shakhs aur woh shakhs jo andheron mein ghira hua hai jin se nikal hi nahin sakta kya yeh dono barabar ho sakte hain? Aur aayat mein hai (Mathalul-fariqayni kal-a'ma wal-asammi wal-basiri was-sami', hal yastawiyani mathala, afala tazakkarun) (Surah Hud: 24), yani in dono jamaton ki misaal andhe behre aur dekhne aur sunne walon ki si hai. Momin toh aankhon aur kaanon wala ujale aur noor wala hai phir rah-e-mustaqeem par hai. Jo sahih taur par sayon aur nehron wali jannat mein pahunche ga aur is ke bar-aks kafir andha behra aur andheron mein phansa hua hai jin se nikal hi na sake ga aur theek jahannam mein pahunche ga. Jo tund-o-tez hararat aur garmi wali aag ka makhzan hai. Allah jise chahe suna de yani is tarah sunne ki taufiq de ke dil sun kar qabool bhi karta jaye. Tu qabr walon ko nahin suna sakta. Yani jis tarah koi marne ke baad qabr mein dafna diya jaye toh use pukarna be-sood hai. Isi tarah kuffar hain ke hidayat-o-dawat un ke liye bekar hai. Isi tarah in mushrikon par badbakhti chha gayi hai aur un ki hidayat ki koi surat baqi nahin rahi toh unhein kisi tarah hidayat par nahin la sakta, tu sirf aagah kar dene wala hai. Tere zimme sirf tableegh hai. Hidayat-o-zalalat min janib-e-Allah hai. Hazrat Adam (A.S) se le kar aaj tak har ummat mein rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aata raha. Taake un ka uzr baqi na reh jaye. Jaise aur aayat mein hai (Wa likulli qawmin had) (Surah Ar-Ra'd: 7) aur jaise farman hai (Walaqad ba'athna fi kulli ummatir-rasulan ani'budullaha wajtanibut-taghut) (Surah An-Nahl: 36), waghaira, in ka tujhe jhoota kehna koi nayi baat nahin in se pehle ke logon ne bhi Allah ke rasoolon ko jhutlaya hai. Jo bade bade mojizat, khuli khuli daleelein, saaf saaf aayatein le kar aaye the aur noorani sahifay un ke hathon mein the, aakhir un ke jhutlane ka natija yeh hua ke main ne unhein azab-o-saza mein giraftar kar liya. Dekh le ke mere inkar ka natija kya hua? Kis tarah tabah-o-barbad hue? Wallahu A'lam.

Rabb ki qudratein. Rabb ki qudraton ke kamalat dekho ke ek hi qisam ki cheezon mein gonagon namoone nazar aate hain. Ek pani aasman se utarta hai aur usi se mukhtalif qisam ke rang-barangay phal paida ho jate hain. Surkh, sabz, safaid waghera. Isi tarah har ek ki khushbu alag-alag, har ek ka zaiqa judagana, jaise aur aayat mein (Wa fil-ardi qita'un mutajawiratun wa jannatun min a'nabin wa zar'un wa nakhilun sinwanun wa gairu sinwanin yusqa bima'in wahidin wa nufaddilu ba'daha 'ala ba'din fil-ukuli inna fi zalika la'ayatin liqawmin ya'qilun) (13. Ar-Ra'd: 4), yani kahin angoor hai, kahin khajoor hai, kahin kheti hai waghera. Isi tarah paharon ki paidaish bhi qisam-qisam ki hai, koi safaid hai, koi surkh hai, koi kala hai. Kisi mein raastay aur ghaatiyan hain. Koi lamba hai, koi na-hamwar hai. In be-jaan cheezon ke baad jaandaar cheezon par nazar daalo. Insaanon ko, janwaron ko, chaupayon ko dekho, in mein bhi qudrat ki waza-waza ki gulkariyan paoge. Barbar, habshi, tamatim bilkul siyah-faam hote hain. Maqaliya, roomi bilkul safaid rang, arab darmiyana, hindi un ke qareeb-qareeb. Chunancha aur aayat mein hai (Wa min aayatihi khalqus-samawati wal-ardi wakhtilafu alsinatikum wa alwanikum inna fi zalika la'ayatin lil-'alimin) (30. Ar-Rum: 22). Tumhari bol-chaal ka ikhtilaf, tumhari rangaton ka ikhtilaf bhi ek aalim ke liye to qudrat ki kamil nishani hai. Isi tarah chaupaye aur deegar haiwanat ke rang-roop bhi alaihda-alaihda hain. Balkay ek hi qisam ke janwaron mein un ki bhi rangatein mukhtalif hain. Balkay ek hi janwar ke jism par kayi-kayi qisam ke rang hote hain. SubhanAllah, sab se achha khaliq Allah kaisi kuch barkaton wala hai. Musnad-e-Bazzar mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se sawal kiya ke kya Allah Ta'ala rang-amezi bhi karta hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya haan, aisa rang rangta hai jo kabhi halka na paray. Surkh, zard aur safaid. Yeh hadith mursal aur mauqoof bhi marwi hai. Is ke baad hi farmaya ke jitna kuch khauf Allah se karna chahiye utna khauf to is se sirf ulama hi karte hain kyunke woh jaanne-boojhne wale hote hain. Haqiqatan jo shakhs jo qadar Allah ki zaat se mutaliq maloomat zyada rakhega, usi qadar is Azeem, Qadeer, Aleem Allah ki azmat-o-haibat us ke dilon mein barhay gi aur usi qadar us ki khashiyat us ke dil mein zyada hogi. Jo jaanay ga ke Allah har cheez par qadir hai, woh qadam-qadam par is se darta rahe ga. Allah ke sath sachha ilm usay hasil hai jo is ki zaat ke sath kisi ko shareek na thahraye, is ke halal kiye hue ko halal aur is ke haram bataye kamon ko haram jaanay, is ke farman par yaqeen kare, is ki nasihat ki nigahbani kare, is ki mulaqat ko bar-haq jaanay, apne a'maal ke hisab ko sach samjhay.

Khashiyat ek quwwat hoti hai jo bande ke aur Allah ki nafarmani ke darmiyan hail ho jati hai. Aalim kehte hi use hain jo dar-parda bhi Allah se darta rahe aur Allah ki raza aur pasand ko chahe, raghbat kare aur uski narazgi ke kamon se nafrat rakhe. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) farmate hain baton ki ziyadati ka naam ilm nahin, ilm naam hai ba-kasrat Allah se darne ka. Hazrat Imam Malik (R.H) ka qaul hai ke kasrat-e-riwayat ka naam ilm nahin, ilm toh ek noor hai jise Allah Ta'ala apne bande ke dil mein daal deta hai. Hazrat Ahmad bin Saleh Misri (R.H) farmate hain ilm kasrat-e-riwayat ka naam nahin, balkeh ilm us ka jis ki tabedari Allah ki taraf se farz hai, yani Kitab-o-Sunnat aur jo ashab aur aimma se pahuncha ho woh riwayat se hi hasil hota hai. Noor jo bande ke aage aage hota hai woh ilm ko aur us ke matlab ko samajh leta hai. Marwi hai ke ulama ki teen qismein hain: Aalim billah, Aalim bi-amr-illah aur Aalim billah wa bi-amr-illah. Aalim billah, Aalim bi-amr-illah nahin aur Aalim bi-amr-illah Aalim billah nahin. Haan, Aalim billah wa bi-amr-illah woh hai jo Allah se darta ho aur hudood-e-faraiz ko janta ho. Aalim billah woh hai jo Allah se darta ho lekin hudood-e-faraiz ko na janta ho. Aalim bi-amr-illah woh hai jo hudood-e-faraiz ko toh janta ho lekin us ka dil Allah ke khauf se khali ho.

Kitabullah ki tilawat ke fazail. Momin bandon ki nek sifatein bayan ho rahi hain ke woh Kitabullah ki tilawat mein mashghool raha karte hain. Imaan ke sath parhte rehte hain, amal bhi hath se jaane nahin dete. Namaz ke paband, zakat-o-khairat ke aadi, zahir-o-batin Allah ke bandon ke sath sulook karne wale hote hain aur woh apne aamal ke sawab ke umeedwar Allah se hote hain, jis ka milna yaqeeni hai. Jaise ke is tafsir ke shuru mein fazail-e-Quran ke zikr mein hum ne bayan kiya hai ke Kalam-e-Allah Sharif apne sathi se kahega ke har tajir apni tijarat ke peeche hai aur tu to sab ki sab tijaraton ke peeche hai. Inhein un ke poore sawab milenge, balkeh bahut barha charha kar milenge jis ka khayal bhi nahin. Allah gunahon ka bakshne wala aur chote aur thore amal ka bhi qadr-daan hai. Hazrat Mutarrif (R.H) to is ayat ko qariyon ki ayat kehte the. Musnad ki ek hadith mein hai, Allah Ta'ala jab kisi bande se raazi hota hai to us par bhalaiyon ki sana karta hai jo us ne ki na hon aur jab kisi se naraz hota hai to isi tarah buraiyon ki. Lekin yeh hadith bahut hi ghareeb hai.

Faza'il-e-Quran: Quran Allah ka haq kalam hai aur jis tarah agli kitabein is ki khabar deti rahi hain yeh bhi un agli sachi kitabon ki sachai sabit kar raha hai. Rabb-e-Khabir-o-Basir hai. Har mustahiq-e-fazeelat ko bakhoobi jaanta hai. Ambiya ko insanon par us ne apne wasee ilm se fazeelat di hai. Phir ambiya mein bhi aapas mein martabay muqarrar kar diye hain aur ala-al-itlaq Huzoor Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka darja sab se bada kar diya hai. Allah Ta'ala apne tamam ambiya par durood-o-salam bheje.

Azmat-e-Quran-e-Kareem aur Millat-e-Baiza. Jis kitab ka oopar zikr hua tha us buzurg kitab yani Quran-e-Kareem ko hum ne apne chida bandon ke hathon mein diya hai yani is ummat ke hathon. Phir hurmat wale kaam bhi is se sarzad ho gaye. Baaz darmiyana darje ke rahe jinhon ne muharramat se toh ijtinab kiya, wajibaat baja late rahe lekin kabhi kabhi koi mustahab kaam un se chhoot bhi gaya aur kabhi koi halki phulki nafarmani bhi sarzad ho gayi. Baaz darjon mein bahut hi aage nikal gaye. Wajibaat chhod kar mustahabbat ko bhi unhon ne na chhoda aur muharramat chhod kar makroohat se bhi yaksar alag rahe. Balkeh baaz martaba mubah cheezon ko bhi darr kar chhod diya. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke pasandida bandon se murad Ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai jo Allah ki har kitab ki waris banayi gayi hai. In mein jo apni janon par zulm karte hain unhein bakhsha jayega aur in mein jo darmiyana log hain un se aasani se hisab liya jayega aur in mein jo nekiyon mein badh jaane wale hain unhein be-hisab jannat mein pahunchaya jayega. Tabrani mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya meri shafa'at meri ummat ke kabira gunah walon ke liye hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain sabiq log toh baghair hisab-o-kitab ke jannat mein dakhil honge aur miyana-ro rahmat-e-Rabb se dakhil-e-jannat honge aur apne nafson par zulm karne wale aur Ashab-e-A'raf Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki shafa'at se jannat mein aayenge. Al-gharaz is ummat ke halke phulke gunahgar bhi Allah ke pasandida bandon mein dakhil hain, falhamdulillah. Go aksar salaf ka qaul yahi hai, lekin baaz salaf ne yeh bhi farmaya hai ke yeh log na toh is ummat mein dakhil hain, na chida aur pasandida hain, na wariseen-e-kitab hain. Balkeh murad is se kafir, munafiq aur bayen hath mein nama-e-a'mal diye jaane wale hain, pas yeh teen qismein wahi hain jin ka bayan Surah Al-Waqi'ah ke awwal-o-aakhir mein hai. Lekin sahih qaul yahi hai ke yeh isi ummat mein hain. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) bhi isi qaul ko pasand karte hain aur aayat ke zahiri alfaaz bhi yahi hain. Ahadees se bhi yahi sabit hota hai. Chunancha ek hadees mein hai ke yeh teenon goya ek hain aur teenon hi jannati hain. (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Yeh hadees ghareeb hai aur is ke rawiyon mein ek rawi hain jin ka naam mazkoor nahin. Is hadees ka matlab yeh hai ke is ummat mein hone ke aitbar se aur is aitbar se ke woh jannati hain goya ek hi hain. Haan martabon mein farq hona lazmi hai. Dusri hadees mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya sabiqeen toh be-hisab jannat mein jayenge aur darmiyana logon se aasani ke sath hisab liya jayega aur apne nafson par zulm karne wale tool-e-mahshar mein roke jayenge. Phir Allah ki rehmaton se talafi ho jayegi aur yeh kahenge Allah ka shukr hai ke us ne hum se gham-o-ranj door kar diya, hamara Rabb bada hi Ghafoor-o-Shakoor hai. Jis ne hamein apne fazl-o-karam se rihayish ki aisi jagah ata farmayi jahan hamein koi dard-o-dukh nahin. (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ibn-e-Abi Hatim (R.H) ki is riwayat mein alfaaz ki kuch kami beshi hai. Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne bhi is hadees ko riwayat kiya hai.

Is mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Sabit masjid mein aate hain aur Hazrat Abu Darda R.A ke paas baith jate hain aur dua karte hain ke Allah! Meri wehshat ka anees mere liye muhayya kar de aur meri gurbat par reham kar aur mujhe koi achha rafeeq ata farma. Yeh sun kar sahabi un ki taraf mutawajja hote hain aur farmate hain main tera saathi hoon sun main aaj tujhe woh hadith-e-Rasool sunata hoon jise main ne aaj tak kisi ko nahin sunayi phir is ayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya Sabiq bil-Khairat toh jannat mein be-hisab jayenge aur Muqtasid logon se aasani ke sath hisab liya jayega aur Zalim-ul-Linafsihi ko is makan mein gham-o-ranj pahunchega. Jis se nijat pa kar woh kahenge Allah ka shukr hai jis ne hum se gham-o-ranj door kar diya. Teesri hadith mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne in teenon ki nisbat farmaya ke yeh sab isi ummat mein se hain. Chauthi hadith: Meri ummat ke teen hisse hain ek be-hisab-o-be-azab jannat mein jane wala. Doosra aasani se hisab liya jane wala aur phir bahisht-nasheen hone wala. Teesri woh jamaat hogi jin se taftish-o-talash hogi lekin phir farishtay hazir ho kar kahenge ke hum ne inhein La ilaha illallah wahdahu kehte hue paya hai Allah Ta'ala farmayega sach hai mere siwa koi mabood nahin achha inhein main ne in ke is qaul ki wajah se chhoda jao inhein jannat mein le jao aur in ki khatayen dozakhiyon par laad do isi ka zikr ayat (Walyahmilunna asqalahum wa asqalam ma'a asqalihim walyus'alunna yaumal qiyamati amma kanu yaftarun) (Surah Al-Ankabut: 13) mein hai yani woh in ke bojh apne bojh ke sath uthayenge is ki tasdeeq is mein hai jis mein farishton ka zikr hai. Allah Ta'ala ne apne bandon mein se jinhein Waris-e-Kitab banaya hai un ka zikr karte hue un ki teen qismein batayi hain pas in mein jo apni janon par zulm karne wale hain woh baz-purs kiye jayenge. (Ibn Abi Hatim) Hazrat Ibn Masood farmate hain ke is ummat ki Qayamat ke din teen jamaatein hongi. Ek be-hisab jannat mein jane wali, ek aasani se hisab liye jane wali, ek gunahgar jin ki nisbat Allah Ta'ala daryaft farmayega halankeh woh khoob janta hai ke yeh kaun hain? Farishtay kahenge Allah in ke paas bade bade gunah hain lekin unhon ne kabhi bhi tere sath kisi ko shareek nahin kiya. Rabb-e-Azz-o-Jal farmayega inhein meri wasee rehmat mein dakhil kar do phir Hazrat Abdullah ne isi ayat ki tilawat farmayi. (Ibn Jarir) Doosra asar. Hazrat Ayesha R.A se is ayat ke bare mein sawal hota hai toh aap farmati hain beta yeh sab jannati log hain Sabiq bil-Khairat toh woh hain jo Rasool Allah ﷺ ke zamane mein the jinhein khud aap ne jannat ki basharat di. Muqtasid woh hain jinhon ne aap ke naqsh-e-qadam ki pairwi ki yahan tak ke un se mil gaye.

Aur zalim-lin-nafsihi mujh tujh jaise hain (Abu Dawood Tayalisi). Khayal farmayiye ke Siddiqa R.A bawajood-e-ke Sabiq-bil-Khairat mein se balkeh un mein se bhi behtareen darjay walon mein se hain lekin kis tarah apne tayin mutawazi banati hain halankeh hadith mein aa chuka hai ke tamam aurton par Hazrat Aisha ko wahi fazeelat hai jo fazeelat Thareed ko har qisam ke ta'am par hai. Hazrat Usman bin Affan R.A farmate hain zalim-lin-nafsihi toh hamare badwi log hain aur Muqtasid hamare shehri log hain aur Sabiq hamare mujahid hain. (Ibn Abi Hatim). Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar R.H farmate hain ke teeno qisam ke log isi ummat mein se hain aur sab jannati hain. Kyunke Allah Ta'ala ne un teeno qisam ke logon ke zikr ke baad jannat ka zikr kar ke phir farmaya (Wallazeena kafaru lahum naru jahannama la yuqda alaihim fayamutu wala yukhaffafu anhum min azabiha kazalika najzi kulla kafoor) (Surah Fatir: 36). Pas yeh log dozakhi hain. (Ibn Jarir). Hazrat Ibn Abbas ne Hazrat Ka'ab se is ayat ke bare mein sawal kiya toh aap ne farmaya Ka'ab ke Allah ki qasam yeh sab ek hi zumray mein hain haan a'amal ke mutabiq un ke darajat kam-o-besh hain. Abu Ishaq Sa'ee bhi is ayat mein farmate hain ke yeh teeno jamatein naji hain. Muhammad bin Hanafiyah farmate hain yeh ummat-e-marhooma hai. Un ke gunahgaron ko bakhash diya jaye ga aur un ke Muqtasid Allah ke paas jannat mein honge. Aur un ke Sabiq buland darjon mein honge. Muhammad bin Ali Baqir R.A farmate hain ke yahan jin logon ko zalim-lin-nafsihi kaha gaya hai yeh woh log hain jinhon ne gunah bhi kiye thay aur nekiyan bhi. In ahadith aur aasar ko samne rakh kar yeh toh saaf maloom ho jata hai ke is ayat mein umoom hai aur is ummat ki in teeno qismon ko yeh shamil hai. Pas ulama-e-kiram is ne'amat ke sath sab se zyada rashk ke qabil hain aur is rahmat ke sab se zyada haqdar hain. Jaise ke Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ke ek shakhs Madine se Damishq mein Hazrat Abu Darda ke paas jata hai aur aap se mulaqat karta hai toh aap daryaft farmate hain ke pyare bhai yahan kaise aana hua? Woh kehte hain is hadith ke sunne ke liye aaya hoon jo aap bayan karte hain. Poocha kya kisi tijarat ki gharz se nahin aaye? Jawab diya nahin. Poocha phir koi aur matlab bhi hoga? Farmaya koi maqsad nahin. Poocha phir kya sirf hadith ki talab ke liye yeh safar kiya hai? Jawab diya ke haan. Farmaya suno main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna hai jo shakhs ilm ki talashi mein kisi rastay ko qata kare Allah use jannat ke raston mein chalaye ga. Allah ki rahmat ke farishtay talib-e-ilmon ke liye par bicha dete hain kyunke woh un se bohat khush hain aur un ki khushi ke khwahan hain. Aalim ke liye aasman-o-zameen ki har cheez istighfar karti hai yahan tak ke pani ke andar ki machliyan bhi. Aabid-o-Aalim ki fazeelat aisi hi hai jaisi chand ki fazeelat sitaron par, ulama nabiyon ke waris hain. Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) ne apne wirsay mein dirham-o-dinar nahin chhore un ka wirsa ilm-e-deen hai.

Jis ne ise liya us ne badi daulat hasil kar li. (Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi waghera) Is hadith ke tamam tareeq aur alfaaz aur sharah main ne Sahih Bukhari Kitab-ul-Ilm ki sharah mein mufassalan bayan kar di hai, falhamdulillah. Surah Taha ke shuru mein woh hadith guzar chuki hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala ulama se farmaye ga: Main ne apna ilm-o-hikmat tumhein is liye hi diya tha ke tumhein bakhsh doon go tum kaise hi ho mujhe is ki kuch parwah hi nahin.

Allah ki Kitab ke waris log. Farmata hai jin barguzida logon ko hum ne Allah ki Kitab ka waris banaya hai unhein Qayamat ke din hamesha wali abadi nematon wali jannaton mein le jayenge. Jahan unhein sone ke aur motiyon ke kangan pehnaye jayenge. Hadith mein hai momin ka zevar wahan tak hoga jahan tak us ke wuzu ka pani pahunchta hai. Un ka libas wahan par khas reshmi hoga. Jis se duniya mein woh muman'at kar diye gaye thay. Hadith mein hai jo shakhs yahan duniya mein harir-o-resham pehne ga woh isay Aakhirat mein nahin pehnaya jaye ga aur hadith mein hai yeh resham kafiron ke liye duniya mein hai aur tum mominon ke liye Aakhirat mein hai. Aur hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Ahl-e-Jannat ke zewaron ka zikr karte hue farmaya unhein sone chandi ke zevar pehnaye jayenge jo motiyon se jadao kiye hue honge. Un par moti aur yaqoot ke taj honge. Jo bilkul shahana honge. Woh naujawan honge baghair baalon ke surmeeli aankhon wale, woh Janab-e-Bari Azza-wa-Jal ka shukriya ada karte hue kahenge ke Allah ka ehsan hai jis ne hum se khauf dar zail kar diya aur duniya aur Aakhirat ki pareshaniyon aur pashmaniyon se humein nijat de di. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke La ilaha illallah kehne walon par qabron mein maidan-e-mahshar mein koi dehshat-o-wahshat nahin. Main to goya unhein ab dekh raha hoon ke woh apne saron par se mitti jhaarte hue keh rahe hain Allah ka shukr hai jis ne hum se gham-o-ranj door kar diya. (Ibn Abi Hatim). Tabrani mein hai maut ke waqt bhi unhein koi ghabrahat nahin hogi. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka farman hai un ki badi badi aur bahut si khatayen maaf kar di gayin aur chhoti chhoti aur kam miqdar nekiyan qadr-dani ke sath qabool farmayi gayin, yeh kahenge Allah ka shukr hai jis ne apne fazl-o-karam lutf-o-rahm se yeh pakeeza buland tareen maqamat ata farmaye hamare a'amal to is qabil thay hi nahin. Chunancha Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai tum mein se kisi ko us ke a'amal Jannat mein nahin le ja sakte logon ne poocha aap ko bhi nahin? Farmaya haan mujhe bhi isi surat Allah ki rahmat sath degi. Woh kahenge yahan to humein na kisi tarah ki shafqat-o-mehnat hai na thakan aur kulfat hai. Rooh alag khush hai jism alag raazi raazi hai. Yeh us ka badla hai jo duniya mein Allah ki rah mein takleefein unhein uthani padi thin aaj rahat hi rahat hai. Un se keh diya gaya hai ke pasand aur dil pasand khate peete raho aur is ke badle jo duniya mein tum ne meri farman-bardariyan keen.

Buray logon ka rooh-farsa haal. Nek logon ka haal bayan farma kar ab buray logon ka haal bayan ho raha hai ke yeh dozakh ki aag mein jaltay jhulsatay rahenge. Unhein wahan maut bhi nahin aayegi jo mar jayen. Jaise aur aayat mein hai (ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوْتُ فِيْهَا وَلَا يَحْيٰي 13ۭ) (Surah Al-A'la: 13) na wahan unhein maut aayegi na koi achi zindagi hogi. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain: Jo abadi jahannami hain unhein wahan maut nahin aayegi aur na achhai ki zindagi milay gi. Woh toh kahenge ke ae darogha-e-jahannam tum hi Allah se dua karo ke Allah hamein maut de de lekin jawab milay ga ke tum toh yahin paray raho ge. Pas woh maut ko apne liye rahmat samjhenge lekin woh aayegi hi nahin. Na marein na azabon mein kami dekhein. Jaise aur aayat mein hai (اِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ فِيْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدُوْنَ 74؀) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 74) yani kuffar da'iman azab-e-jahannam mein rahenge jo azab kabhi bhi na hatenge na kam honge. Yeh tamam bhalai se mahaz mayoos honge aur jagah farman hai (كُلَّمَا خَبَتْ زِدْنٰهُمْ سَعِيْرًا 97؀) (Surah Al-Isra: 97) aag-e-jahannam hamesha tez hoti rahe gi. Farmata hai (فَذُوْقُوْا فَلَنْ نَّزِيْدَكُمْ اِلَّا عَذَابًا 30؀) (Surah An-Naba: 30) lo ab mazay chakho, azab hi azab tumhare liye barhtay rahenge. Kafiron ka yahi badla hai, woh cheekh-o-pukar karenge haye-waye karenge duniya ki taraf lautna chahenge iqrar karenge ke hum gunah nahin karenge nekiyan karenge. Lekin Rabb-ul-Aalameen khoob jaanta hai ke agar yeh wapas bhi jayenge toh wahi sarkashi karenge isi liye unka yeh arman pura na hoga. Jaise aur jagah farmaya ke unhein unke is sawal par jawab milay ga ke tum toh wahi ho ke jab Allah ki wahdaniyat ka bayan hota tha toh tum kufr karne lagtay thay wahan uske sath shirk karne mein tumhein maza aata tha. Pas ab bhi agar tumhein lauta diya gaya toh wahi karoge jis se muman'at kiye jatay ho. Pas farmaya unhein kaha jayega ke duniya mein toh tum bohat jiye, tum is lambi muddat mein bohat kuch kar saktay thay maslan sattarah saal jiye. Hazrat Qatadah (R.A) ka qaul hai ke lambi umr mein bhi Allah ki taraf se hujjat puri karna hai. Allah se panah mangni chahiye ke umr ke barhne ke sath hi insaan buraiyon mein barhta chala jaye dekho toh yeh aayat jab utri hai us waqt ba'az log sirf atharah saal ki umr ke hi thay. Wahb bin Munabbah (R.H) farmatay hain murad bees saal ki umr hai. Hasan (R.H) farmatay hain chalees saal. Masrooq (R.H) farmatay hain chalees saal ki umr mein insaan ko hoshiyar hojana chahiye. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain is umr tak pahunchna Allah ki taraf se uzr-bandi hojata hai. Aap hi se saath saal bhi marwi hain aur yahi zyada sahih bhi hai. Jaise ek hadith mein bhi hai go Imam Ibn Jarir (R.H) is ki sanad mein kalam kartay hain lekin woh kalam theek nahin. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se bhi saath saal hi marwi hain. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain Qayamat ke din ek munadi yeh bhi hogi ke saath saal ki umr ko pahunch janay walay kahan hain?

Lekin is ki sanad theek nahin. Musnad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jise Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne saath sattar baras ki umr ko pahuncha diya us ka koi uzr phir Allah ke haan nahin chalega. Sahih Bukhari Kitab-ur-Riqaq mein hai us shakhs ka uzr Allah ne kaat diya jise saath saal tak duniya mein rakha. Is hadith ki aur sanadein bhi hain lekin agar na bhi hotin toh bhi sirf Hazrat Imam Bukhari (R.H) ka ise apni Sahih mein warid karna hi is ki sehat ka suboot tha. Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ka yeh kehna ke is ki sanad ki jaanch ki zaroorat hai Imam Bukhari (R.H) ke sahih kehne ke muqable mein ek jau ki bhi qeemat nahin rakhta. Wallahu A'lam, baaz log kehte hain atibba ke nazdeek tab'i umr ek sau bees baras ki hai saath saal tak toh insaan barhotri mein rehta hai. Phir ghatna shuru ho jata hai. Pas aayat mein bhi isi umr ko murad lena achha hai aur yahi is ummat ki ghalib umr hai. Chunancha ek hadith mein hai meri ummat ki umrein saath se sattar saal tak hain aur is se tajawuz karne wale kam hain. (Tirmidhi waghera). Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) toh is hadith ki nisbat farmate hain is ki aur koi sanad nahin lekin ta'ajjub hai ke Imam Sahab ne yeh kaise farma diya? Is ki ek dusri sanad Ibn-e-Abi-ud-Dunya mein majood hai. Khud Tirmidhi mein bhi yahi hadith dusri sanad se Kitab-uz-Zuhd mein marwi hai. Ek aur za'eef hadith mein hai meri ummat mein sattar saal ki umr wale bhi kam honge aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se aap ki ummat ki umr ki babat sawal hua toh aap ne farmaya pachaas se saath saal tak ki umr hai. Poocha gaya sattar saal ki umr wale? Farmaya bahut kam Allah un par aur assi saal walon par apna raham farmaye. (Bazzar). Is hadith ka ek rawi Usman bin Matar qawi nahin. Sahih hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki umr tressath saal ki thi, ek qaul hai ke saath saal ki thi, yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke painsath baras ki thi. Wallahu A'lam. (Tatbiq yeh hai ke saath saal kehne wale rawi dahaiyon ko lagate hain ikaiyon ko chhor dete hain, painsath saal wale saal-e-tawallud aur saal-e-wafat ko bhi ginte hain aur tressath wale in dono barson ko nahin lagate. Pas koi ikhtilaf nahin, Falhamdulillah. Mutarjim). Aur tumhare paas darane wale aa gaye yani safed baal. Ya khud Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam). Zyada sahih qaul dusra hi hai jaise farman hai (Haza nazeerun min-an-nuzur-il-oola) yeh paighambar nazeer hain. Pas umr de kar, Rasool bhej kar apni hujjat poori kar di. Chunancha Qayamat ke din bhi jab dozakhi tamanna-e-maut karenge toh yahi jawab milega ke tumhare paas haq aa chuka tha yani Rasoolon ki zabani hum paigham-e-haq tumhein pahuncha chuke the lekin tum na maane aur aayat mein hai (Wa ma kunna mu'azzibina hatta nab'asa rasoola) (Surah Al-Isra: 15) hum jab tak Rasool na bhej dein azab nahin karte. Surah Tabarak-allazi mein farman hai jab jahannami jahannam mein dale jayenge wahan ke daroghe un se poochenge ke kya tumhare paas darane wale nahin aaye the?

Yeh jawab denge ke haan aaye the lekin hum ne unhein na maana, unhein jhoota jaana aur keh diya ke Allah Ta'ala ne toh koi kitab waghera nazil nahin farmayi. Tum yunhi bak rahe ho, pas aaj roz-e-qayamat un se keh diya jayega ke nabiyon ki mukhalifat ka maza chakho, muddat-ul-umr unhein jhutlate rahe, ab aaj apne aamal ke badle uthao aur sun lo koi na khada hoga jo tumhare kaam aa sake, tumhari kuch madad kar sake aur azabon se bacha sake ya chura sake.

Pas ab bhi agar tumhein lauta diya gaya toh wahi karoge jis se muman'at kiye jatay ho. Pas farmaya unhein kaha jayega ke duniya mein toh tum bohat jiye, tum is lambi muddat mein bohat kuch kar saktay thay maslan sattarah saal jiye. Hazrat Qatadah (R.A) ka qaul hai ke lambi umr mein bhi Allah ki taraf se hujjat puri karna hai. Allah se panah mangni chahiye ke umr ke barhne ke sath hi insaan buraiyon mein barhta chala jaye dekho toh yeh aayat jab utri hai us waqt ba'az log sirf atharah saal ki umr ke hi thay. Wahb bin Munabbah (R.H) farmatay hain murad bees saal ki umr hai. Hasan (R.H) farmatay hain chalees saal. Masrooq (R.H) farmatay hain chalees saal ki umr mein insaan ko hoshiyar hojana chahiye. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain is umr tak pahunchna Allah ki taraf se uzr-bandi hojata hai. Aap hi se saath saal bhi marwi hain aur yahi zyada sahih bhi hai. Jaise ek hadith mein bhi hai go Imam Ibn Jarir (R.H) is ki sanad mein kalam kartay hain lekin woh kalam theek nahin. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se bhi saath saal hi marwi hain. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain Qayamat ke din ek munadi yeh bhi hogi ke saath saal ki umr ko pahunch janay walay kahan hain?

Lekin is ki sanad theek nahin. Musnad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jise Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne saath sattar baras ki umr ko pahuncha diya us ka koi uzr phir Allah ke haan nahin chalega. Sahih Bukhari Kitab-ur-Riqaq mein hai us shakhs ka uzr Allah ne kaat diya jise saath saal tak duniya mein rakha. Is hadith ki aur sanadein bhi hain lekin agar na bhi hotin toh bhi sirf Hazrat Imam Bukhari (R.H) ka ise apni Sahih mein warid karna hi is ki sehat ka suboot tha. Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ka yeh kehna ke is ki sanad ki jaanch ki zaroorat hai Imam Bukhari (R.H) ke sahih kehne ke muqable mein ek jau ki bhi qeemat nahin rakhta. Wallahu A'lam, baaz log kehte hain atibba ke nazdeek tab'i umr ek sau bees baras ki hai saath saal tak toh insaan barhotri mein rehta hai. Phir ghatna shuru ho jata hai. Pas aayat mein bhi isi umr ko murad lena achha hai aur yahi is ummat ki ghalib umr hai. Chunancha ek hadith mein hai meri ummat ki umrein saath se sattar saal tak hain aur is se tajawuz karne wale kam hain. (Tirmidhi waghera). Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) toh is hadith ki nisbat farmate hain is ki aur koi sanad nahin lekin ta'ajjub hai ke Imam Sahab ne yeh kaise farma diya? Is ki ek dusri sanad Ibn-e-Abi-ud-Dunya mein majood hai. Khud Tirmidhi mein bhi yahi hadith dusri sanad se Kitab-uz-Zuhd mein marwi hai. Ek aur za'eef hadith mein hai meri ummat mein sattar saal ki umr wale bhi kam honge aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se aap ki ummat ki umr ki babat sawal hua toh aap ne farmaya pachaas se saath saal tak ki umr hai. Poocha gaya sattar saal ki umr wale? Farmaya bahut kam Allah un par aur assi saal walon par apna raham farmaye. (Bazzar). Is hadith ka ek rawi Usman bin Matar qawi nahin. Sahih hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki umr tressath saal ki thi, ek qaul hai ke saath saal ki thi, yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke painsath baras ki thi. Wallahu A'lam. (Tatbiq yeh hai ke saath saal kehne wale rawi dahaiyon ko lagate hain ikaiyon ko chhor dete hain, painsath saal wale saal-e-tawallud aur saal-e-wafat ko bhi ginte hain aur tressath wale in dono barson ko nahin lagate. Pas koi ikhtilaf nahin, Falhamdulillah. Mutarjim). Aur tumhare paas darane wale aa gaye yani safed baal. Ya khud Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam). Zyada sahih qaul dusra hi hai jaise farman hai (Haza nazeerun min-an-nuzur-il-oola) yeh paighambar nazeer hain. Pas umr de kar, Rasool bhej kar apni hujjat poori kar di. Chunancha Qayamat ke din bhi jab dozakhi tamanna-e-maut karenge toh yahi jawab milega ke tumhare paas haq aa chuka tha yani Rasoolon ki zabani hum paigham-e-haq tumhein pahuncha chuke the lekin tum na maane aur aayat mein hai (Wa ma kunna mu'azzibina hatta nab'asa rasoola) (Surah Al-Isra: 15) hum jab tak Rasool na bhej dein azab nahin karte. Surah Tabarak-allazi mein farman hai jab jahannami jahannam mein dale jayenge wahan ke daroghe un se poochenge ke kya tumhare paas darane wale nahin aaye the?

Yeh jawab denge ke haan aaye the lekin hum ne unhein na maana, unhein jhoota jaana aur keh diya ke Allah Ta'ala ne toh koi kitab waghera nazil nahin farmayi. Tum yunhi bak rahe ho, pas aaj roz-e-qayamat un se keh diya jayega ke nabiyon ki mukhalifat ka maza chakho, muddat-ul-umr unhein jhutlate rahe, ab aaj apne aamal ke badle uthao aur sun lo koi na khada hoga jo tumhare kaam aa sake, tumhari kuch madad kar sake aur azabon se bacha sake ya chura sake.

Wasi-ul-Ilm Allah Ta'ala ka farman. Allah Ta'ala apne wasee aur be-payan ilm ka bayan farma raha hai ke woh aasman-o-zameen ki har cheez ka aalim hai, dilon ke bhed, seenon ki baatein us par ayan hain. Har aamil ko us ke amal ka badla woh de ga, us ne tumhein zameen mein ek dusre ka khalifa banaya hai. Kafiron ke kufr ka wabaal khud un par hai. Woh jaise jaise apne kufr mein barhte hain waise hi Allah ki narazgi un par barhti hai aur un ka nuqsan aur ziyan hota jata hai. Barkhilaf momin ke ke us ki umar jis qadar barhti hai nekiyan barhti hain aur darje pata hai aur Allah ke haan maqbool hota jata hai.

Mudallal paigham. Allah Ta'ala apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se farma raha hai ke aap mushrikon se farmayiye ke Allah ke siwa jin jin ko tum pukara karte ho tum mujhe bhi toh zara dikhao ke unhon ne kis cheez ko paida kiya hai? Ya yehi sabit kardo ke aasmanon mein unka kaunsa hissa hai? Jab ke na woh khaliq na saajhi phir tum mujhe chhod kar unhein kyun pukaro? Woh toh ek zarre ke bhi maalik nahin. Acha ye bhi nahin toh kam az kam apne kufr-o-shirk ki koi kitabi daleel hi pesh kardo. Lekin tum ye bhi nahin kar sakte. Haqeeqat ye hai ke tum sirf apni nafsani khwahishon aur apni raye ke peeche lag gaye ho daleel kuch bhi nahin. Baatil jhoot aur dhoke baazi mein mubtala ho. Ek dusre ko fareb de rahe ho, apne in jhoote maboodon ki kamzori apne samne rakh kar Allah Ta'ala ki jo saccha mabood hai qudrat-o-taqat dekho ke aasman-o-zameen uske hukm se qaim hain. Har ek apni jagah ruka hua aur thama hua hai. Idhar udhar junbish bhi toh nahin kar sakta. Aasman ko zameen par gir padne se Allah Ta'ala roke hue hai. Ye dono uske farman se thehre hue hain. Uske siwa koi nahin jo unhein tham sake, rok sake, nizam par qaim rakh sake. Is Haleem-o-Ghafoor Allah ko dekho ke makhlooq-o-mamlook, nafarmani-o-sarkashi, kufr-o-shirk dekhte hue bhi barbadi aur bakhshish se kaam le raha hai, dheel aur mohlat diye hue hai. Gunahon ko maaf farmata jata hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein is aayat ki tafseer mein ek ghareeb balkay munkar hadith hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ka ek waqia Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek martaba mimbar par bayan farmaya ke aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke dil mein khayal guzra ke Allah Ta'ala kabhi sota bhi hai? Toh Allah Ta'ala ne ek farishta unke paas bhej diya jisne unhein teen din tak sone na diya. Phir unke ek ek haath mein ek ek botal de di aur hukm diya ke inki hifazat karo ye girein nahin tootein nahin. Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) unhein hathon mein le kar hifazat karne lage lekin neend ka ghalba hone laga oongh aane lagi. Kuch jhakole toh aise aaye ke aap hoshiyar ho gaye aur botal girne na di lekin aakhir neend ghalib aa gayi aur botalen haath se chhoot kar zameen par gir gayin aur choora choora ho gayin. Maqsad ye tha ke sone wala do botalen bhi tham nahin sakta. Phir Allah Ta'ala apni sifaat mein farma chuka hai ke use na toh oongh aaye na neend. Zameen-o-Aasman ki kul cheezon ka maalik sirf wahi hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hadith hai ke Allah Ta'ala na toh sota hai na sona uski shayan-e-shan hai. Woh tarazu ko ooncha neecha karta rehta hai. Din ke amal raat se pehle aur raat ke aamaal din se pehle uski taraf chadh jate hain. Uska hijab noor hai. Ya aag hai. Agar use khol de toh uske chehre ki tajalliyan jahan tak uski nigah pahunchti hai sab makhlooq ko jala dein. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke ek shakhs Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) ke paas aaya aap ne us se daryaft farmaya ke kahan se aa rahe ho? Usne kaha Shaam se. Poocha wahan kis se mile? Kaha Ka'ab se. Poocha Ka'ab ne kya baat bayan ki?

Kaha yeh ke aasman ek farishtay ke kandhay tak ghoom rahay hain. Poocha tum ne isay sach jana ya jhutla diya? Jawab diya kuch bhi nahin. Farmaya phir toh tum ne kuch bhi nahin kiya. Suno Hazrat Ka'ab ne ghalat kaha phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat farmayi. Is ki asnaad sahih hai. Doosri sanad mein aanay walay ka naam hai ke woh Hazrat Jundub Bajli thay. Hazrat Imam Malik bhi is ki tardeed kartay thay ke aasman gardish mein hain aur isi aayat se daleel letay thay aur is hadith se bhi jis mein hai maghrib mein ek darwaza hai jo tauba ka darwaza hai woh band na hoga jab tak ke aaftab maghrib se tulu na ho. Hadith bilkul sahih hai. Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'alam.

Qasmein kha kar mukarne wale zalim. Quraish ne aur Arab ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ba'asat se pehle bari sakht qasmein kha rakhi thin ke agar Allah ka koi Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum mein aaye toh hum tamam duniya se zyada uski tabedari karenge. Jaise aur jagah farman hai (An taqulu innama unzilal kitabu ala taifataini min qablina wa in kunna an dirasatihim laghafilin) (Surah Al-An'am: 156), yani is liye ke tum yeh na keh sako ke hum se pehle ki jamaton par toh albatta kitabein utrein. Lekin hum toh un se be-khabar hi rahe. Agar hum par kitab utarti toh hum un se bahut zyada rah-yafta ho jate. Toh lo ab toh khud tumhare paas tumhare Rab ki bheji hui daleel aa pahunchi, hidayat-o-rahmat khud tumhare hathon mein di ja chuki, ab batao ke Rab ki aayaton ki takzeeb karne walon aur un se munh modne walon se zyada zalim kaun hai? Aur aayaton mein hai ke yeh kaha karte the ke agar hamare apne paas agle logon ke ibrat-nak waqiat hote toh hum toh Allah ke mukhlis bande ban jate. Lekin phir bhi unhon ne is ke un ke paas aa chukne ke baad kufr kiya, ab unhein anqareeb is ka anjam maloom ho jayega. Un ke paas Allah ke aakhri Paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur Rab ki aakhri aur afzal-tar kitab aa chuki lekin yeh kufr mein aur barh gaye, unhon ne Allah ki baatein manne se takabbur kiya, khud na maan kar phir apni makkariyon se Allah ke dusre bandon ko bhi Allah ki rah se roka. Lekin unhein bawar kar lena chahiye ke is ka wabaal khud un par parega. Yeh Allah ka nahin albatta apna bigaar rahe hain. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain makkariyon se parhez karo, makr ka bojh makkar par hi parta hai aur is ki jawab-dahi Allah ke han hogi. Hazrat Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi (R.H) farmate hain ke teen kamon ka karne wala nijat nahin pa sakta, in kamon ka wabaal un par yaqeenan aayega: makr, baghawat aur wadon ko tor dena. Phir aap ne yahi aayat parhi, unhein sirf isi ka intezar hai jo in jaise in pehle guzarne walon ka haal hua ke Allah ke Rasoolon ki takzeeb aur farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki mukhalifat ki wajah se Allah ke daimi azab un par aa gaye. Pas yeh toh Allah Ta'ala ki aadat hi hai aur tu gaur kar. Rab ki aadat badalti nahin na paltati hai. Jis qaum par azab ka irada ho chuka phir us irade ke badalne par koi qudrat nahin rakhta ke un par se azab hatein na woh un se bachein. Na koi unhein ghuma sake. Wallahu A'alam.

Ibrat-naak manazir se sabaq lo. Hukm hota hai ke in munkiron se farma dijiye ke zameen mein chal phir kar dekhein toh sahi ke in jaise in se pehle ke logon ka kaisa ibrat-naak anjam hua. Un ki ne'matein chhin gayin, un ke mahalaat ujaar diye gaye, un ki taqat tanha ho gayi, un ke maal tabah kar diye gaye, un ki auladein halak kar di gayin, Allah Ta'ala ke azaab un par se kisi tarah na tale. Aayi hui museebat ko woh na hata sake, noch liye gaye, tabah-o-barbad kar diye gaye, kuch kaam na aaya, koi faida kisi se na pohancha. Allah Ta'ala ko koi hara nahin sakta, use koi amr aajiz nahin kar sakta, us ka koi irada kamyabi se juda nahin, us ka koi hukm kisi se tal nahin sakta. Woh tamam kainat ka aalim hai, woh tamam kaamon par qadir hai. Agar woh apne bandon ke tamam gunahon par pakad karta toh tamam aasmanon wale aur zameenon wale halak ho jate. Janwar aur rizq tak barbad ho jate. Janwaron ko un ke ghonslon aur bhatton mein bhi azaab pohanch jata. Zameen par koi janwar baqi na bachta. Lekin ab dheel diye hue hai, azaabon ko mu'akhar kiye hue hai, waqt aa raha hai ke Qayamat qaim ho jaye aur hisab-kitab shuru ho jaye. Itaat ka badla aur sawab mile. Na-farmani ka azaab aur us par saza ho. Ajal aane ke baad phir takheer nahin milne ki. Allah Azza-wa-Jal apne bandon ko dekh raha hai aur woh bakhoobi dekhne wala hai.

Ibrat-naak manazir se sabaq lo. Hukm hota hai ke in munkiron se farma dijiye ke zameen mein chal phir kar dekhein toh sahi ke in jaise in se pehle ke logon ka kaisa ibrat-naak anjam hua. Un ki ne'matein chhin gayin, un ke mahalaat ujaar diye gaye, un ki taqat tanha ho gayi, un ke maal tabah kar diye gaye, un ki auladein halak kar di gayin, Allah Ta'ala ke azaab un par se kisi tarah na tale. Aayi hui museebat ko woh na hata sake, noch liye gaye, tabah-o-barbad kar diye gaye, kuch kaam na aaya, koi faida kisi se na pohancha. Allah Ta'ala ko koi hara nahin sakta, use koi amr aajiz nahin kar sakta, us ka koi irada kamyabi se juda nahin, us ka koi hukm kisi se tal nahin sakta.
